mcat_description.short: Industrial Shed Fabrication is a construction service covering the design, supply, fabrication, and on-site erection of steel-framed roofed structures — including Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) and conventional MS portal frame sheds — for factories, warehouses, godowns, and workshops.
mcat_description.long: Industrial shed fabrication in India encompasses the complete turnkey delivery of structural steel buildings, from structural design and engineering (per IS:800 for steel structures, IS:875 for wind/seismic loads) through factory fabrication of primary and secondary members to on-site erection and cladding. The two dominant construction systems are Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) — where columns, rafters, purlins, and wall panels are factory-prefabricated to precise specifications and bolted on-site — and conventional mild steel (MS) portal frame construction using hot-rolled IS:2062 sections welded or bolted on-site. Roofing and cladding options include colour-coated PPGI/PPGL sheets, GI corrugated sheets, PUF/EPS insulated sandwich panels, polycarbonate sheets, and FRP sheets, with accessories such as ridge ventilators, skylights, gutters, and louvers. Buyers are typically SME manufacturers, logistics operators, agri-storage developers, and industrial estate developers who evaluate span width, eave height, wind load compliance, insulation, and total project cost per sq ft.

market_context: Industrial shed fabrication in India is a large, fragmented construction services market dominated by two structural systems: Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) — factory-prefabricated steel components bolted on-site — and conventional mild steel (MS) portal frame construction. PEB has become the preferred system for medium-to-large spans (above 15m) due to faster erection timelines (typically 16–22 weeks vs 30+ weeks for conventional builds) and lower material waste. Structural design compliance is governed by IS:800 (steel structure design), IS:875 (wind and seismic loads), and IS:1893 (earthquake zones), with material grades specified under IS:2062 (E250/E350 hot-rolled sections). Roofing materials range from colour-coated PPGI/PPGL sheets and GI corrugated sheets to PUF/EPS insulated sandwich panels and polycarbonate sheets; wall cladding options include insulated sandwich panels, GI sheets, and Aerocon panels. Key buyer-evaluated dimensions are clear span width (up to 60m column-free for PEB), eave height (6m–15m standard), wind load rating, insulation specification, and total cost per sq ft. Prominent Indian PEB manufacturers include EPACK Prefab, Metal Tree, Interarch, Kirby, Zamil, and Tata BlueScope Steel. The market serves SME manufacturers, logistics operators, agri-storage developers, and industrial estate developers across all Indian states, with strong demand clusters in Maharashtra (Pune, Chakan), Gujarat (Vadodara, Surat), Tamil Nadu (Chennai, Trichy), Haryana (Faridabad), and Uttar Pradesh (Ghaziabad, Varanasi). Buyers frequently search by location ('shed work near me', 'industrial shed fabrication in Varanasi') indicating a local-contractor procurement pattern for smaller projects alongside national PEB suppliers for larger ones.
